title: fix(app-shell): record create/update toasts name the saved record
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi99R9hXJTYYUhUGGdHBZb4ty)_

Fixes #26172

Clause-②: no (adds or rewords message keys; no key is removed, so `TranslationKeys` only widens; no exported runtime contract changes)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What

The Console's record create and update success toasts now name the saved record by its display name (ADR-0079), as the ruled `ux-conventions.write-feedback` clause asks: `Task "Quarterly review" created`, `Task "Quarterly review" updated`. A record with nothing nameable keeps today's object-label toast (`Task created successfully`).

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`: one message builder, `recordSaveMessage(saved)`, now serves both toast sites, the main path (`handleCrudSuccess`, which hands the message to the runner's `crud_success`) and the child-form task path (a subtable child opened over its parent's record page, which toasts directly). `handleRecordFormSuccess` passes the saved record it already receives to both. The name comes from `getRecordDisplayName` in `@object-ui/core`, read through the object being saved (`formObjectDef`), so it follows the object's declared `nameField`. The resolver's floor (`Record #ID`, or the empty fallback for a row with no id) is not a name, and falls back to the object-label string. This is the same floor test `recordToOption` in `LookupField` and `renderLookupColumnValue` already use.
- `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` (all ten packs): two new keys, `form.createdNamed` and `form.updatedNamed`, each with `{{object}}` (object label) and `{{title}}` (record name), quoted the way each pack already quotes a name (`deleteConfirmTitle` is the model: curly quotes in zh, corner brackets in ja, low-high quotes in de, straight quotes elsewhere). `form.createSuccess` / `form.updateSuccess` are unchanged and stay the no-name toast.
- `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/i18n.json`: re-recorded by `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` (1 of 27 package records moved: i18n). `sdui.manifest.json` itself is unchanged.
- Two count pins in `ui/packages/i18n` move with the diff: `de-quote-pairing-3876` (94 to 96 matched pairs, the two new de values) and `residue-namespaces-3546` (the `common.record` fallback in AppContent is written once now, 2 to 1).
- Root changeset `.changeset/26172-record-save-toast-names-record.md` (patch, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/i18n`).

Out of scope, per the ruling: settings saves and flow-completion toasts.

## Tests

New: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.recordSaveToastNamesRecord-26172.test.tsx`, a real `AppContent` mount in a real i18next instance (the harness of `AppContent.createLandingOriginPlural-11733`). Nine cells: main path and child-form path, each for create and update, each with a name and with none, plus one zh-CN cell (`任务“季度复盘”已创建`).

- New file: 9/9 passed.
- Ablation (committed fix, `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor `const title = resolved && !(id` replaced by `const title = false && resolved && !(id`; anchor 1 to 0, blob `66183e3229a8` to `a12d7507a89f`): 5 failed / 4 passed. All five "names the record" cells went red (`expected 'Task created successfully' to be 'Task "Quarterly review" created'`), and the four no-name cells stayed green, the direction written in the test's header before the run. Restore: blob back to `66183e3229a8` equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `vitest run packages/i18n/ packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/`: first run 3 failed (the two count pins above), 1694 passed. After re-pinning, the two files: 52/52 passed.
- Every other test file under `ui/` that names `AppContent.tsx` or `form.createSuccess` / `form.updateSuccess` (14 files): 89/89 passed.
- Test runs were at `3c5713b5`. The one later commit (`e9bd0d06`) only re-records `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/i18n.json`.

Narrowed on purpose: the whole `app-shell` suite (about 1700 files) is left to CI `Test Core` / `Build & E2E UI`.

## Acceptance notes

- On an edit, the name is read off what the save returned (`dataSource.update`'s `record`). The toast can only name the record if that response carries the name field. The ObjectStack adapter returns the server's `record`. A live server was not booted for this PR.
- Serial: `ui/packages/i18n` is held by the batch PR #26158. This PR stays draft. Merging main, re-recording `i18n.json` and enqueuing wait until that batch has merged and the ui seat says go. The two count pins above may need a re-pin at that merge if the batch moves the same counts.
